svg.title: Building 01 — cupola, raised pediment and terrace rail
svg.desc: A more source-specific visible-front drawing based on KA-002 and KA-001. Wide facade with a tall ribbed onion cupola and cartouches at the rounded left corner, large concave-shouldered raised center pediment, four differentiated tall-window levels, grouped swaged iron balconies, continuous lowest terrace, open arcade. It is interpretive and not measured.

g.aria-label: Wide facade massing and curved left return
Large ribbed onion cupola, pointed lantern finial and oval cartouches
Large fluted central pediment and oval crest
Segmented upper parapet and iron panels
Four tall window tiers with source-specific rail grouping
Continuous terrace rail with repeated hourglass balusters
Open round-arched ground arcade without inserted crossbars
